arxiv-2002-01524.title: Storage Optimal Control under Net Metering Policies
arxiv-2002-01524.creator: Md Umar Hashmi, Arpan Mukhopadhyay, Ana Bušić, Jocelyne Elias
arxiv-2002-01524.description: Abstract Electricity prices and the end user net load vary with time. Electricity consumers equipped with energy storage devices can perform energy arbitrage, i.e., buy when energy is cheap or when there is a deficit of energy, and sell it when it is expensive or in excess, taking into account future variations in price and net load.

arxiv-2103-12960.title: Nuclear matter in relativistic Brueckner-Hartree-Fock theory with Bonn potential in the full Dirac space
arxiv-2103-12960.creator: Sibo Wang, Qiang Zhao, Peter Ring, Jie Meng
arxiv-2103-12960.description: Abstract Starting from the Bonn potential, relativistic Brueckner-Hartree-Fock (RBHF) equations are solved for nuclear matter in the full Dirac space, which provides a unique way to determine the single-particle potentials and avoids the approximations applied in the RBHF calculations in the Dirac space with positive-energy states (PESs) only.

arxiv-2209-10321.title: CryptoSolve: Towards a Tool for the Symbolic Analysis of Cryptographic Algorithms
arxiv-2209-10321.creator: Dalton Chichester, Wei Du [0000-0002-9149-6229], Raymond Kauffman, Hai Lin [0000-0001-8658-9634], Christopher Lynch [0000-0003-1141-0665], Andrew M. Marshall [0000-0002-0522-8384], Catherine A. Meadows, Paliath Narendran [0000-0003-4521-5892], Veena Ravishankar [0000-0003-3498-4039], Luis Rovira, Br
arxiv-2209-10321.description: Abstract Recently, interest has been emerging in the application of symbolic techniques to the specification and analysis of cryptosystems. These techniques, when accompanied by suitable proofs of soundness/completeness, can be used both to identify insecure cryptosystems and prove sound ones secure. But although a number of such symbolic algorithms have been developed and implemented, they remain scattered throughout the literature.

arxiv-2407-07875.title: Generative Image as Action Models
arxiv-2407-07875.creator: Mohit Shridhar, Yat Long Lo, Stephen James
arxiv-2407-07875.description: Abstract Image-generation diffusion models have been fine-tuned to unlock new capabilities such as image-editing and novel view synthesis. Can we similarly unlock image-generation models for visuomotor control? We present Genima , a behavior-cloning agent that fine-tunes Stable Diffusion to “draw joint-actions” as targets on RGB images.

arxiv-2408-01434.title: Behind the Smile: Mental Health Implications of Mother-Infant Interactions Revealed Through Smile Analysis Thanks: This work is supported by the California Initiative to Advance Precision Medicine – ACES and The Saban Research Institute Developmental Neuroscience and Neurogenetics Program, CHLA.

arxiv-2408-01434.description: Abstract Mothers of infants have specific demands in fostering emotional bonds with their children, characterized by dynamics that are different from adult-adult interactions, notably requiring heightened maternal emotional regulation. In this study, we analyzed maternal emotional state by modeling maternal emotion regulation reflected in smiles.

arxiv-2505-21348.title: Quantum harmonic oscillator, index theorem and spectral asymmetry
arxiv-2505-21348.creator: Shunrui Li, and Yang Liu
arxiv-2505-21348.description: Abstract We report a spectral asymmetry effect in the quantum harmonic oscillator, where its partition function is identified as the Chern character. This establishes a direct link between statistical mechanics, and topological invariants (Atiyah-Singer index theorem), revealing the internal energy as a non-SUSY manifestation of the index theorem.

arxiv-2508-00645.title: SmartFlow: A CFD-solver-agnostic deep reinforcement learning framework for computational fluid dynamics on HPC platforms
arxiv-2508-00645.creator: Maochao Xiao, Yuning Wang, Felix Rodach, Bernat Font, Marius Kurz, Pol Suárez, Di Zhou, Francisco Alcántara-Ávila, Ting Zhu, Junle Liu, Ricard Montalà, Jiawei Chen, Jean Rabault, Oriol Lehmkuhl, Andrea Beck, Johan Larsson, Ricardo Vinuesa, Sergio Pirozzoli
arxiv-2508-00645.description: Abstract Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) is emerging as a powerful tool for fluid-dynamics research, encompassing active flow control, autonomous navigation, turbulence modeling and discovery of novel numerical schemes. We introduce SmartFlow, a CFD-solver-agnostic framework for both single- and multi-agent DRL algorithms that can easily integrate with MPI-parallel CPU and GPU-accelerated solvers.

pmc-12513911.title: Identification of Trail Following and Alarm Pheromones of Lasius Flavus Using Bioassay-Directed Fractionation
pmc-12513911.creator: Thomas Butterfield, Jonathan Bacon, Elizabeth M Hill
pmc-12513911.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The identity of trail following pheromones secreted by the ant Lasius flavus were investigated using bioassay-directed fractionation techniques. Extracts of whole bodies were fractionated by high performance liquid chromatography and fractions tested for trail following activity in circular bioassays. Active fractions were analysed by gas chromatography- mass spectrometry (GC-MS) and structures of potential pheromones were confirmed by comparison with synthetic standards. The pheromones 2,6-dimethyl-5-heptenol (DMH) and mellein were identified in active fractions from extracts of whole body and headless ants respectively.
